agents.name: drug_shortages
agents.description: List current US prescription drug shortages from the FDA Drug Shortage Database (refreshed daily). Optionally filter by drug name or drug class. Returns the generic name, brand names, how long the shortage has been running, and how many manufacturers are affected. Useful for checking whether a drug a plan or patient depends on is in shortage before a refill or formulary decision.
reasons: This capability helps check for drug shortages, which is crucial information when trying to refill a prescription.
uncertainties: Execution requires a fresh readiness check.
